21: A person should not give all of his charity (lit., monies) to just one poor person.

One who distributes charity must take care not to favor (lit., increase towards) his relatives more than other people. Rem"a: [This law applies] particularly to a Gabbai [distributors of communal charity], but everyone may give their charity or their Ma'aser to whomever from their relatives, and they take precedence as was explained above in Siman 251 (Mordechi First Chapter of Bava Batra)
